answer: To deter Sybil agents, assign each identity a small random audit duty before it can earn. One agent checks a pearl inventory, another traces a ripple in payment records, and a third verifies an umber pigment shipment. Auditors must cite independently verifiable evidence; matching fabricated evidence triggers loss of a posted bond. A swarm of fake identities then requires real verification work and risks forfeiting a bond for each dishonest account.
